tool.name: MiniMak Coil Demo Simulator
tool.description: Synthetic coil-command generator for MiniMak demo sequences
tool.command: python '$__tool_directory__/coil_demo_sim.py' --demo $demo --duration '$duration' --timestep-ms '$timestep_ms' --aoinc '$aoinc' --v-max '$v_max' --v-min '$v_min' --alimit '$alimit' --output-csv output.csv --output-png output.png && mv output.csv '$output_csv' && mv output.png '$output_png'

param.name: demo
param.label: Demo sequence
param.help: Which MiniMak demo sequence to simulate (reproduces TimerAO_Tick logic from FormMain.vb)
param.option: SQ1 - TF1 Demo: ramp TF bank 1 (AO ch 0)
SQ2 - TF2 Demo: ramp TF bank 2 (AO ch 1)
SQ3 - PF Demo 1: ramp PF bank 1 (AO ch 2)
SQ7 - PF Demo 2: alternate ramp PF1 / PF2 (ring movement)

param.name: duration
param.label: Simulation duration (s)
param.help: Total length of the simulated sequence in seconds

param.name: timestep_ms
param.label: Timestep (ms)
param.help: Control loop timer period in milliseconds - matches FormMain UI default

param.name: aoinc
param.label: Voltage step per tick (V)
param.help: Ramp accumulator increment multiplier per tick - matches FormMain UI default

param.name: v_max
param.label: Ramp ceiling (V)
param.help: Maximum voltage before the ramp resets to v_min

param.name: v_min
param.label: Ramp floor (V)
param.help: Voltage at which the ramp resets

param.name: alimit
param.label: Hardware output clamp (V)
param.help: Maximum voltage the DAQ hardware can output

data.name: output_csv
data.label: Coil voltage time-series (CSV)
data.help: Per-tick PSU setpoint voltages for all four channels - feed into the Magpy Field Solver

data.name: output_png
data.label: Channel voltage plot (PNG)
data.help: Step plot of active channel voltages over the simulated sequence

tool.help:
**MiniMak Coil Demo Simulator**
Reproduces the synthetic coil-command sequences from the MiniMak firmware (TimerAO_Tick logic, FormMain.vb) as a Galaxy tool.
**Demo sequences**
+------+----------+------------------------------------------------+ | Code | Label | Description | +------+----------+------------------------------------------------+ | 1 | SQ1 TF1 | Sawtooth ramp on TF bank 1 (AO ch 0) | | 2 | SQ2 TF2 | Sawtooth ramp on TF bank 2 (AO ch 1) | | 3 | SQ3 PF1 | Sawtooth ramp on PF bank 1 (AO ch 2) | | 4 | SQ4 PF2 | Sawtooth ramp on PF bank 2 (AO ch 3) | | 7 | SQ7 PF2R | Alternate ramp PF1 / PF2 - simulates vertical | | | | ring movement | | 8 | SQ8 TF+PF| Alternate ramp TF1 / PF1 | +------+----------+------------------------------------------------+
**Channel mapping** (AO = analogue output from PC DAQ card)::
AO ch 0 -> TF bank 1 (Lianshu PSU) AO ch 1 -> TF bank 2 (Lianshu PSU) AO ch 2 -> PF bank 1 (ZJIVnV PSU, ÷2 scaling) AO ch 3 -> PF bank 2 (ZJIVnV PSU, ÷2 scaling)
**Output CSV columns**::
t_ms, t_s, TF1, TF2, PF1, PF2
The CSV output can be passed directly to the **Magpy Field Solver (Time Series)** tool to compute the evolving magnetic field for the simulated sequence.
